specifications.filter_classification_en1.note: Sheet lists three available grades (E12/H13/H14) in a slash-separated family row; H14 is the third and highest grade listed. Efficiencies are listed in the same slash-separated format mapping to E12/H13/H14 respectively. The selection chart (page 3) confirms H14 units are sold. Value derives from the rightmost grade in the slash-list.

specifications.mpps_efficiency_pct.note: Three minimum-efficiency values correspond to E12/H13/H14 respectively; 99.995 is the rightmost (H14) value. Efficiencies are generic to the product family, not stated as a standalone H14-only row.

specifications.efficiency_at_0_3_micron_.note: Three values correspond to E12/H13/H14 respectively; 99.999 is the rightmost (H14) value. Note the H14 value lacks the ≤ sign that precedes the E12/H13 values — an apparent PDF typesetting inconsistency.

specifications.scan_tested.quote: Each filter is scan tested individually per EN 1822, ensuring a leak proof performance.

variants.0.performance.pressure_drop_in_.note: This is the Initial Pressure Drop from the selection chart, not the recommended final pressure drop (2.00 in wg from page 2).

variants.1.performance.airflow_cfm.note: Two rows exist for the EHHT900-24x24x12 model reference in the selection chart: (1) actual dims 23.30x23.30x11.50 → CFM=950, media=155; (2) actual dims 24x24x11.50 → CFM=1000, media=166. The 24x24x11.50 row is the correct match for a variant declared as 24x24x11.5 inches. The 23.30x23.30 row represents the same nominal size with tighter actual dimensions.

variants.1.performance.pressure_drop_in_.note: Initial Pressure Drop from the selection chart.
